positive_snippets:
All the banquet halls look lavish and well decorated. My guests really enjoyed my wedding in the property there. Great variety of cuisine available. Mr. Rishabh and Mr.Ahuja were very supportive towards us.
But we faced problems with the lift (low maintenance & balance issue) and ACs in some rooms were not working. Otherwise, it's a decent venue.

I recently attended an event at L’Elegant Hotel & Banquet, and while the entrance looks quite lavish and impressive, the experience inside was a bit different. The hall at the backside is quite small and congested, especially if your guest list crosses 150–200 people. It tends to feel packed very quickly, which can be uncomfortable during peak event hours.

The food was just okay, nothing extraordinary. Overall, it’s suitable for small gatherings, but if you're planning a bigger event or expecting a seamless flow of guests, you may want to reconsider the hall size beforehand.
